parameters.content: **Pickup reminders.** Every morning at 08:00 (instance timezone) ask Convex which approved loans start tomorrow. Each loan is handled on its own: one email to the borrower, one to the owner, and only when both went out an immediate write-back so Convex does not remind again today. A failed address is recorded and skipped, never blocking the others. Convex returns at most 200 loans per call and excludes already-reminded ones, so when more remain the workflow fetches again (up to 10 pages). If anything failed, the run ends with one summarized error so the error workflow fires. Use Run manually to test.
